questions.prompt: Before the shot clock, the Fort Wayne Pistons beat the Lakers in 1950 with how many points?
questions.context: Fort Wayne Pistons vs Minneapolis Lakers · November 22, 1950

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: defeated the Minneapolis Lakers by a record-low score of 19–18, including 3–1 in the fourth quarter.

funFacts.text: Fort Wayne attempted just 13 field goals during the entire low-scoring game.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: they attempted 13 shots for the game

funFacts.text: The slow-down strategy was designed to keep the ball away from Lakers giant George Mikan.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: to limit the impact of the Lakers' dominant George Mikan

funFacts.text: A St. Paul newspaper condemned the Pistons' tactic as a black eye for pro basketball.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: gave pro basketball a great black eye
